reference_action: Immediate post-repot wilting; advice says give time and bright light. OP reports already unwilting about two hours later. Central observed resolution is recovery with time, not proof that added watering, humidity or root products caused improvement.

sources.reason: One comment reassures just shock but asks for watering/sun, while others prescribe smaller-pot repot and deep drying. No explicit patient recovery without further intervention.
Shock diagnosis and preventive product/potting regimen, not an explicit waiting remedy.
Explicit be patient after transplant shock; partial retrieval of recovery-time advice amid unvalidated additional interventions.
Do not dig up shocked plant and give it a day of rest matches waiting/rest portion.
Root-rot rescue requires unpotting, cleaning, peroxide and repotting before monitoring. Waiting after that extensive treatment is not equivalent to letting a newly repotted plant recover on its own.

actions.action: Repot into pot at most two inches wider than root mass
Check deep soil dryness before watering again
Water if not done after repot or once deep soil dries
Provide some sun while preventing sunburn

resolved.reason: Recognizes shock but buries reassurance under another repot and incompatible watering instructions. Extra repot could prolong stress, although no evidence establishes severe harm; main patience recommendation is not explicit.

harmfulness.reason: The final comment cautions against sunburn and makes initial watering conditional. Nonetheless, “repot in a smaller pot” can repeat the disturbance that caused this case, without evidence the current pot is oversized.

specificity_accuracy.reason: “It’s just shock” matches the immediate onset after root rinsing. The competing pot-size/rot explanation and “dry way down” instruction come from a different plant and do not supply the straightforward time-to-recover answer.

feasibility.reason: A two-inch rootball allowance is concrete and the work uses common supplies. The reader must choose between watering now and waiting for deep drying, plus interpret how much sun is safe, making execution ambiguous.
